description: A client-side Minecraft mod that removes distance limitations from jukebox music.

mods.name: Jukebox Range
mods.description: Extends jukebox music range on the client, with constant volume and an optional infinite mode.

releases.notes:
Jukebox Infinite Range 1.0.3

Initial public release!

Features:
Removes distance attenuation from jukebox music.
Keeps jukebox audio centered in both ears.
Allows music to continue playing regardless of player distance.
Client-side implementation. No server installation required.

Known limitation:
Breaking a jukebox while far away does not immediately stop its currently playing music. The track finishes naturally.

Compatibility:
Minecraft 26.3
Fabric
Java 25+
